sourceText: Section 3: assign a maximum of eight marks for up to four details across the two questions relating to Section 3.
decision: Retain the joint question because the scheme explicitly makes one shared allocation across the two parts; it does not give separate marks for each part. Splitting into2+6 would remove the scheme’s permission to count any four details across both questions. This is not a screenshot-based bundle.
rule: R7: split only where the scheme gives separate marks for things answered separately.
countTreatment: Keep both independently counted printed asks and the single scheme-defined task. No exclusion and no erased ask.
